value.message: Installing exclusion lists will prevent "easy-to-guess" passwords from being used by users within this instance.  ServiceNow provides 3 different size lists of commonly used password but you can also add your own entries to the
There are 3 different sizes of default exclusion list provided by ServiceNow that can be used as a good way to get started.

You can also add your own items to the exclusion lists.  The full exclusion list includes a combination of your own entries and any ServiceNow provided exclusion lists that are installed.

When adding custom list items including localizations, some suggestions are:

  • Add any relevant brand or product names
  • Add common locations, such as company headquarters
  • Add company-specific internal terms or abbreviations

The small, medium and large lists are loaded sequentially and their contents do not overlap.  For example, loading the large list will also load the small and medium lists if they have not been loaded previously.
